relations.subject: Karl Albert Agathon Benary
relations.evidence: He was the brother of orientalist Franz Ferdinand Benary (1805–1880).

relations.subject: Karl Albert Agathon Benary
relations.evidence: He received his education at the gymnasiums in Göttingen and Erfurt, where he was a student of Franz Ernst Heinrich Spitzner.

relations.subject: Karl Albert Agathon Benary
relations.evidence: From 1824 to 1827 he studied classical philology at the universities of Göttingen and Halle

relations.subject: Karl Albert Agathon Benary
relations.evidence: From 1824 to 1827 he studied classical philology at the universities of Göttingen and Halle, obtaining his doctorate with the dissertation "De Aeschyli Prometheo soluto".

relations.subject: Karl Albert Agathon Benary
relations.evidence: At Halle he was especially influenced by the teachings of Christian Karl Reisig.

relations.subject: Karl Albert Agathon Benary
relations.evidence: continued his philological studies as a pupil of Franz Bopp

relations.subject: Karl Albert Agathon Benary
relations.evidence: From 1833 up until his death in 1860, he was associated with the Cölnischen Realgymnasium in Berlin.

relations.subject: Karl Albert Agathon Benary
relations.evidence: During this time period, he also gave lectures at the University of Berlin.
